play.definition: A deep passing concept in which the primary receiver releases vertically or on an angled stem, gains more than 25 yards of depth beyond the line of scrimmage, and then bends or breaks across the field toward the opposite sideline. The receiver maintains speed through the crossing path while the quarterback uses extended timing, sustained protection, play action, rollout movement, or a deeper pocket set to deliver the ball into the deep crossing window.

Action_None.label: None
Action_None.definition: A temporal label used when the player is visible but is not performing any defined football action in the action taxonomy during the annotated interval.

Action_PassBlock.label: Pass Block
Action_PassBlock.definition: An offensive lineman or other offensive player's action to protect the quarterback from defensive rushers, establishing a pocket and preventing sacks or pressure.

Action_PreSnap.label: Pre Snap
Action_PreSnap.definition: The period before the snap when players are set in formation and no active play has begun.

Action_RunDeepCrossRoute.label: Run Deep Cross Route
Action_RunDeepCrossRoute.definition: A receiver's route action consisting of a vertical or angled stem followed by a deep crossing path across the middle of the field.

Action_SnapReceive.label: Snap Receive
Action_SnapReceive.definition: The action of the quarterback securing the ball from the center’s snap to initiate the play.

Action_ThrowPass.label: Throw Pass
Action_ThrowPass.definition: A quarterback's or other eligible passer's action of propelling the football forward with a legal throwing motion toward an intended receiver.
